exposure: type of decision maker during pregnancy
presence of the husband accompanying their wives in any of the ANC visits
outcome: Birth Preparedness and Complication Readiness (BPACR) status
cohort: 200 postnatal mothers in the Indoor Patient Department (IPD), Department of Gynaecology and Obstetrics, in a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India
finding: Good birth preparedness was significantly associated with older age, involvement of the woman in pregnancy decision-making, and husband's presence during antenatal care visits.
